objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-impair-defense-change-win-defender-health-check-intervals
objects.description: The following analytic detects modifications to the Windows registry that change the health check interval of Windows Defender. It leverages data from the Endpoint datamodel, specifically monitoring changes to the "ServiceKeepAlive" registry path with a value of "0x00000001". This activity is significant because altering Windows Defender settings can impair its ability to perform timely health checks, potentially leaving the system vulnerable. If confirmed malicious, this could allow an attacker
